steps.say: Spinal tuberculosis eats the front of the bone first. Blood-borne bacilli settle where the disc meets the body.
steps.tx: **Tuberculosis** (TB germ illness) reaches the **paradiscal anterior vertebral body** (disc edge front bone, **paradiscal lesion**) through **Batson plexus** (spine vein web), favouring lower thoracic and upper lumbar levels, with the disc spared early unlike pyogenic destruction of the disc in bacterial infection.

steps.say: Cold abscesses, skip lesions and humps mark the disease. Late pedicle destruction separates it from tumours.
steps.tx: **Cold abscesses** (painless pus pockets) track along psoas shadows, paravertebral lines widen, pedicles erode late unlike tumour, **skip lesions** (separate level spots) occur, and **Gibbus deformity** (sharp hump bend) marks anterior collapse in children with longstanding disease, with night cries from vertebral tenderness often reported.

steps.say: MRI plus a needle proves it. Subligament spread with disc signal plus GeneXpert separates TB from cancer and pus.
steps.tx: MRI shows **subligamentous spread** (under band extension) across levels with a relatively preserved disc and rim-enhancing abscesses, and CT-guided biopsy with **GeneXpert CBNAAT** (rapid TB gene test) plus culture confirms diagnosis and **rifampicin resistance** (first drug failure) in one sitting, with HIV testing routine in every new spinal case.

steps.say: Twelve months of observed drugs cure most. Two months of four drugs then ten of three remains the spinal standard.
steps.tx: **NTEP and INDEX-TB guidance** (TB program norms) treat drug-sensitive spinal TB with **2 months of HRZE** (four drug start) then **10 months of HRE** (three drug run), a **12 month ATT** (year long drugs, **2HRZE/10HRE** course code) with directly observed adherence and nutrition support for bony healing.

steps.say: Tuli taught restraint. No deficit, no wobble and no hump means drugs and a brace, not steel.
steps.tx: **Tuli middle path** (restraint doctrine) manages without surgery when there is no deficit, instability or deformity, using ATT with **bracing** (belt support) and serial neurology, since most **paradiscal disease** (disc edge illness) heals medically with bony fusion across the disc.

steps.say: Deficit, wobble, hump or failed drugs trigger surgery. Front cleaning with strut plus back screws is the workhorse.
steps.tx: Surgery is indicated for **progressive deficit** (worsening weakness), spinal instability, severe kyphosis, no response after **3 to 6 months** (three to six months) of ATT, or diagnostic doubt, via anterior debridement with **strut graft** (bone block) plus posterior instrumentation, with panvertebral disease needing combined approaches.

steps.say: The Hong Kong operation set the standard. Radical front cleaning with rib strut still anchors anterior disease.
steps.tx: The **Hong Kong radical anterior debridement** (front clean operation) with **rib strut grafting** (rib bone block) remains the gold standard for anterior disease with large abscesses, while pure posterior approaches suit limited posterior element disease with facet and lamina involvement.

steps.say: Big healed humps and resistant bugs need more. Osteotomy straightens, bedaquiline kills.
steps.tx: **60 degree kyphosis** (sixty degree hump) or progressing deformity in healed disease needs corrective **osteotomy** (bone cut straightening), and drug-resistant spine TB gets **bedaquiline-based NTEP regimens** (new drug courses) with surgical debulking for load reduction, plus brace protection through the healing months.
